name: Hey_4
short_caption: The robot lifts its right arm and waves in a friendly greeting.
movement_description: The robot begins by raising its right arm up and out to the side with an open hand facing forward. It performs a brief waving motion, swaying the arm slightly back and forth from the elbow. After a moment, it smoothly lowers the arm back down to its side, returning to a neutral standing posture.
safety_notes: The right arm sweeps outward and upward to the side; ensure adequate lateral clearance on the robot's right.
